mutations.name: lost-queued-refresh-under-ordered-channel
mutations.why: Same mutation as mutations.json lost-queued-refresh, but the link delivers a read's reply before the event that follows it (Ordered = TRUE): the queued re-read is then redundant, so the mutation is expected MISSED. Evidence for the W4 candidate 'queued flag is dead under in-order delivery'; the code does not enforce that order, so it stays.
mutations.search:
/\ inFlight' = [inFlight EXCEPT ![d] = TRUE]       \* refresh() right after
               /\ req' = [req EXCEPT ![d] = TRUE]
